title: The Anubis Mystery
subtitle: A Holiday Interrupted by a Nervous Stranger
summary: Feluda’s quiet holiday takes a sharp turn when a mysterious, anxious caller seeks his help, launching the famous sleuth and his cousin into another puzzle. With only a nervous voice and a cryptic request to go on, Feluda’s curiosity is piqued—setting the stage for a new case shrouded in secrets. Who is Nilmoni Sanyal, and what urgent mystery awaits on Roland Road?
